test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a component of the core infrastructure sectors of India (as per the Index of Eight Core Industries)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telecommunications**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Index of Eight Core Industries represents the performance of eight key sectors that are essential for the growth of the Indian economy.
 
• The eight core sectors include Coal, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Refinery Products, Fertilizers, Steel, Cement, and Electricity.
 
• Telecommunications is not a part of the Eight Core Industries as listed by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India.
 
• The Eight Core Industries collectively contribute about 40.27% to the overall weight of items included in the Index of Industrial Production (IIP).
 
• The inclusion of these sectors is based on their significant impact on infrastructure development and industrial growth in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Steel**

 
 
• Steel is one of the eight core industries and a key material used in construction, infrastructure, and manufacturing.
 
• India is among the top producers of steel globally, with significant contributions to industrial growth.
 
• The production and consumption of steel are closely linked to economic development and infrastructure expansion.
 
 
 
• **Electricity**
 
 
• Electricity generation is a crucial component of the core industries as it powers industrial and economic activities.
 
• India has a diverse electricity generation portfolio, including thermal, hydro, nuclear, and renewable energy sources.
 
• Electricity production is essential for sustaining industrial output and improving the standard of living.
 
 
 
• **Cement**
 
 
• Cement is a vital raw material for construction and infrastructure projects.
 
• The cement industry plays a crucial role in India's infrastructure development, including housing, roads, and bridges.
 
• India is one of the largest producers of cement globally, contributing significantly to economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Telecommunications**
 
 
• Telecommunications is a major sector in India but is not included in the Eight Core Industries.
 
• It is governed by the Department of Telecommunications and plays a vital role in connecting people and businesses.
 
• India is one of the largest mobile phone markets in the world, and advancements in telecommunications have supported the digital transformation of the country.
